confidence_notes: I based the restaurant, coffee and beer anchors on aggregated cost-of-living figures from 2026 web searches. These included Wise (inexpensive meal about $19, cappuccino about $3.9, beer about $4.0) and Numbeo (city meal about $19.7, cappuccino about $4.2, regional beer about $3.5). In Argentina, inflation and exchange-rate swings make USD prices change quickly. I estimated the mid-range meal from the usual ratio to the inexpensive-meal price and from typical regional levels. I didn't get direct aggregated figures for cocktails or wine. I estimated those from their usual local price relationship to beer and from general knowledge, keeping in mind that Argentine wine is relatively cheap. All accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live listings. They are the least certain and can vary with season and neighbourhood, with Palermo and Recoleta costing more.
comparable_city_reasoning: Buenos Aires prices in 2026 are high for South America after recent dollar-price inflation, roughly in line with Santiago and Montevideo. I benchmarked accommodation against those cities and Buenos Aires' large hostel market.
